body: Ni mifumo MIWILI TOFAUTI ya hifadhi ya jamii. NSSF (National Social Security Fund): pensheni na manufaa ya muda mrefu — inafadhiliwa na michango ya mwajiri (10%) na mfanyakazi (10%). NHIF (National Health Insurance Fund): bima ya afya — inafadhiliwa kwa njia tofauti. Wafanyakazi wa sekta binafsi kawaida wanchangia NSSF; watumishi wa serikali wanaweza kuchangia NHIF. Ni mifumo miwili tofauti yenye mamlaka tofauti.
keep: NHIF (National Health Insurance Fund): bima ya afya
why: CLEAN and REAL: our own training answer (batch_006) states NSSF's 10%/10% right beside an NHIF mention that carries no figure of its own. The must-pass the founder named: the correct NSSF part is untouched.
